ctx.x: Did you know a clarinet player from Bay St. Louis named Sumner Labatt? Remember him? Kind of straight clarinet player.

Yeah, Sumner Labatt. You probably wouldn't remember him, but he's still over there last I heard. He said, say he sounded sort of like Mealy Barnes, if you remember Mealy Barnes. Used to be with Chris Kelly and those guys. Well, anyway. He just used to go out on tours around then on the weekends.
